bible.show_premise: After being abandoned at the altar by her fiancé, a humiliated noblewoman marries a mysterious scarred warrior who is secretly the rightful Duke reclaiming his stolen throne.

characters.name: Lady Juliana
characters.role: The resilient heroine abandoned at the altar who fights for justice using her late mother's herbal remedies.

characters.name: Alexander
characters.role: The scarred, rugged warrior and rightful Duke who marries Juliana and reclaims his birthright.

characters.name: Gerald
characters.role: Juliana's cruel ex-fiancé who abandons her for her sister Clarissa and conspires against her.

characters.name: Clarissa
characters.role: Juliana's spiteful sister who marries Gerald and torments Juliana.

characters.name: Catherine
characters.role: The treacherous noblewoman who conspires to poison the Dowager Duchess and steal the ducal seat.

characters.name: Rupert
characters.role: Catherine's co-conspirator in usurping the ducal throne and framing Juliana.

characters.name: Dowager Duchess
characters.role: Alexander's poisoned mother whose life Juliana secretly tries to save.

arcs: Juliana is abandoned at the altar by Gerald and Clarissa, then rescued and married by a mysterious scarred stranger.
Juliana and Alexander build a peaceful life in a woodland cottage while facing repeated harassment and arson from Gerald and his thugs.
Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor to treat the poisoned Dowager Duchess, only to be framed for witchcraft and poisoning by Rupert and Catherine.
Alexander discovers his mother and learns of the treasonous coup, returning from the dead to storm Catherine and Rupert's wedding.
Alexander reclaims his ducal title and exposes the conspirators, though an ecclesiastical challenge briefly threatens his marriage to Juliana.

reveals.reveal: Juliana is abandoned at the altar by her fiancé Gerald for her sister Clarissa.
The mysterious scarred warrior Alexander marries Juliana in exile.
Gerald Harrington is behind the violent thugs attacking Juliana's medicinal garden.
Rupert and Catherine are systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic to seize the ducal seat.
Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for witchcraft and send her to the dungeon.
Alexander is revealed to be the true Duke of Ashburn whose throne was usurped.
The High Priest invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding due to a lack of a royal license.
